target_customer: Homeowners buying lawn care, and independent lawn professionals who get jobs
problem: Finding and booking a reliable lawn care provider relied on Craigslist and Yelp. Lawn Love gave instant online quotes and booked vetted independent pros.
business_model: Marketplace take rate of 10 to 20 percent of contractor revenue, per VentureBeat 2014

founders.name: Jeremy Yamaguchi
founders.background_notes: VentureBeat says he built the company largely alone at first; he is the only founder on the YC page.

competitors.name: Homejoy
competitors.what: On-demand home cleaning marketplace using the same independent provider model

competitors.name: Craigslist and Yelp
competitors.what: The existing way customers found lawn services

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace app with satellite based yard sizing for instant quotes, scheduling, payments and routing. Standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Local supply of lawn pros was easy to replicate and customers could go around the platform; LawnStarter and others ran the same model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it. A direct competitor, LawnStarter, acquired it in August 2021 in a cash and stock deal.

market_need_then: In 2014 VentureBeat described customers finding lawn pros through Craigslist and Yelp, and the founder had operated a similar home services business before.

identity.logo: A heart in the logo, per a Snappr photo caption

branding.community_and_virality: Pitched in press as the Uber of lawn care.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive friendly name with a trademarked tagline and local press, kept as a standalone consumer brand after the acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Lawn Love launched in San Diego in 2014, raised a 1.9 million dollar seed after YC and a company stated 6.7 million dollars in total by 2021, and expanded to many cities. LawnStarter acquired it in August 2021 for undisclosed cash and stock and kept the brand running. Steady marketplace growth with modest capital led to a competitor consolidation exit, though deal value is not public.
notes: The 6.7 million dollar total is from the acquisition release; only the 2014 seed is itemized so coverage is partial. Aggregators give conflicting totals ($2M to $33M) and were not used. Investors Bullpen Capital and others appear in the release but their rounds are undated.
